name: leak-extract
summary: The Chapter 12 extortion-operation extractor across two surfaces: leak-site victim parsing, snapshot-diff lifecycle, cross-site repost mirror/clone detection, negotiation-transcript arc + tactic extraction, and a public-vs-private bluff cross-check — graded by the leak scorer.

modules.victims.py: Leak-site victim-entry parser to a typed record, with class-then-label resilience (reuses Ch11 listing helpers) so a leak-site restyle does not empty fields.
modules.lifecycle.py: Diffs leak-site snapshots per victim to classify transitions and surface countdown theatre (slid deadlines) and quiet withdrawals.
modules.reposts.py: Detects a victim reposted across sites and calls it a mirror (affiliate movement, same claim) or clone (recycled/inflated claim), reusing the Ch10 shingler.
modules.negotiation.py: Parses a negotiation transcript into an arc (opening, offers, proof, settlement, outcome) and classifies operator tactics.
modules.correlate.py: Cross-checks a victim's public claim against its private transcript to flag bluffs: slid-deadline theatre, inflated volume, sold-as-leverage, unverifiable deletion.
modules.pipeline.py: Runs the whole extraction over the corpus (naive vs full); --selftest grades itself with the leak scorer.

corpus: corpus/ — the leak lab: a dedicated leak site (RedLattice) at two snapshots with victim entries and indexes, a markup-drift variant, a rebrand site (BlackVault) reposting two victims (one mirror, one inflated clone), and four negotiation transcripts. All watermarked synthetic.
